## ClaudeMC v1.7

**Minecraft:** 1.21.1 · **Fabric Loader:** 0.16.5 · **Fabric API:** 0.100.7+1.21.1 · **Java:** 21

### New in v1.7

#### Live Exploit Database — auto-fetched on every startup
The exploit database is now fetched from GitHub on every Minecraft launch (background thread, doesn't delay startup).

- **Source:** `.github/exploits.json` in this repository — always up to date with the latest commit
- **Cache:** stored at `.minecraft/config/claudemc/exploits_cache.json`, refreshed every 6 hours
- **Fallback:** uses stale cache if offline; shows status in the Server Info screen top-right corner
- **11 exploits** in the initial DB: FADAH, AuctionHouse, BookDupe, ForceOP (CommandBlock + BungeeCord), EssentialsX vanish leak, CMI vanish leak, ShopGUI+ race, ForceCreative abilities spoof, Geyser UUID leak, Vault amplification

#### Confirmed Exploit Detection
After joining a server, ClaudeMC waits ~5 seconds (to allow plugin channel packets to arrive), then cross-references the detected brand and plugin list against every entry in the exploit DB.

An exploit is **CONFIRMED** when:
- Every `requires_software` entry matches the server brand string, AND
- Every `requires_plugins` entry is present in the detected plugin channel namespaces

**Confirmed exploits get:**
- A **pulsing bright green border** in the Exploits tab of the Server Info screen
- A `✓ CONFIRMED` badge at the start of the row
- A **chat notification** on join: `⚠ N confirmed exploits found on this server!`

#### Server Info screen — Exploits tab
The Server Info screen now has two tabs:
- **[Exploits]** (default) — all matched exploits sorted confirmed-first, with severity colour coding and a red badge count of confirmed entries on the tab itself
- **[Plugins]** — detected brand + plugin channels with vulnerability severity stripes (unchanged from v1.6)

Click any exploit row to expand a detail panel: severity, module to use, techniques, full description, patched versions.
